metadata.description: Full-Stack Developer skill for Claude — complete skill plus focused packs.

plugins.name: fullstack-developer
plugins.description: Complete skill: websites, web apps, APIs, mobile and desktop apps, GSAP and 3D sites, WordPress, slides and videos from a simple prompt in any language.

plugins.name: fullstack-web
plugins.description: Web & SaaS pack — Senior web engineer that builds websites, web apps, SaaS, dashboards, e-commerce, APIs and single-file React artifacts from a plain-language prompt in any language — Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Supabase, FastAPI, payments, SEO.

plugins.name: fullstack-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile Apps pack — Senior mobile engineer that builds Android and iOS apps from a plain-language prompt in any language — React Native + Expo (or Flutter), Supabase backends, offline storage, push notifications, EAS builds to APK, Play Store and App Store.

plugins.name: fullstack-desktop
plugins.description: Desktop Software & Scripts pack — Senior desktop engineer that builds Windows, macOS and Linux software, POS and inventory systems, CLIs and automation scripts from a plain-language prompt in any language — Python (Tkinter/PySide6), Tauri, Electron, SQLite, installers.

plugins.name: fullstack-motion-3d
plugins.description: Animation, 3D & Presentations pack — Creative front-end engineer that builds premium animated websites with GSAP (ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Flip), Three.js / React Three Fiber 3D experiences and animated HTML slide decks from a plain-language prompt in any language.

plugins.name: fullstack-wordpress
plugins.description: WordPress pack — WordPress engineer that builds block themes (theme.json, templates, patterns, style variations) and custom Gutenberg blocks from a plain-language prompt in any language.

plugins.name: fullstack-video
plugins.description: Programmatic Video pack — Video engineer that creates promo videos, social clips (16:9 and 9:16), animated captions and data-driven personalized videos with Remotion (React → MP4) from a plain-language prompt in any language.
